package answer

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// ActivityAnswerInput represents taskAnswer.activity command payload.
type ActivityAnswerInput struct {
	AnswerID  string
	StudentID string
}

// ActivityAnswer handles the taskAnswer.activity command and re-opens answers
// that are allowed to leave FAILED/REJECTED under user activity.
type ActivityAnswer struct {
	Answers         repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	TaskProvider    TaskProvider
	LearningActions repository.LearningActionLifecycleRepository
}

// Handle processes activity command.
func (uc ActivityAnswer) Handle(ctx context.Context, in ActivityAnswerInput) error {
	answer, err := uc.Answers.GetByID(ctx, in.AnswerID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Check if user matches
	if answer.StudentID != in.StudentID {
		return domain.ErrForbidden
	}

	// Convert to IN_PROCESS only if FAILED or REJECTED and not exceeded maxAttempts
	if answer.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed || answer.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusRejected {
		task, err := taskForAnswer(ctx, uc.TaskProvider, answer)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// Check if can retry (not exceeded maxAttempts)
		if task.MaxAttempts == nil || answer.Attempt < *task.MaxAttempts {
			answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress
			answer.EndedAt = nil
			answer.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
			if uc.LearningActions != nil {
				action, actionErr := newLearningAction(*answer, task, answer.UpdatedAt)
				if actionErr != nil {
					return actionErr
				}
				if _, actionErr = uc.LearningActions.ReopenAnswer(ctx, *answer, action); actionErr != nil {
					return actionErr
				}
			} else if err := uc.Answers.Update(ctx, *answer); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}

	return nil
}
